The Hon'Ble Smt Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Criminal Petition No.5879 Of 2020
Order:

-
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 read with 457 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seeking a direction to the Station House Officer/Court concerned to release the vehicle i.e.
Ashok Leyland Dosti bearing registration No.AP 16 TE 5315 and tobacco products seized in connection with F.I.R. No.203 of 2020 of Kurnool Taluq Police Station, Kurnool District.

entities.text: Kurnool Taluq Police Station, Kurnool District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. The above said crime has been registered against the petitioners under Sections 188, 273 and 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and 59(i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 against which, the petitioners herein have filed Criminal Petition No.2328 of 2020 before this Court seeking to quash the said F.I.R.

This Court has allowed the said criminal petition vide common order dated 29.07.2020, basing on the earlier orders passed by this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.5169 of 2019 and 5103 of 2019 and batch.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Subsequently when the petitioners approached the concerned Police for return of the seized vehicle and tobacco products they refused to return on the ground that there is no order for releasing the same.
Hence, the present criminal petition is filed.

3. Heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and Public Prosecutor for the respondent-state.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that Section 451 Cr.P.C. applies for return of the property pending investigation, Section 452 applies to a case where trial is concluded and Section 457 of Cr.P.C. applies where the property is not produced during trial.
In this case the crime itself is quashed and hence the seized property is no more required to be retained.
5. Learned Public Prosecutor has not disputed the above submissions.

6. Taking into consideration that the above F.I.R. has already been quashed by this Court by common order dated 29.07.2020 passed in Criminal Petition Nos.1788 of 2020 and batch, the property that was seized from the petitioners herein in connection with the said F.I.R. is liable to be returned to them.

7. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the Station House Officer, Kurnool Tq Police Station, Kurnool is directed to release the vehicle i.e. Ashok Leyland Dosti bearing No.AP 16 TE 5315 as well as the tobacco products seized in connection with F.I.R.No.203 of 2020.
